mapper.sql:
SELECT r.outReqId AS outReqId, r.comId AS comId, c.comName AS comName, r.outDateWish AS outDateWish, r.outDttmReq AS outDttmReq, r.outDttmAppr AS outDttmAppr, r.isTempo AS isTempo, r.isDelete AS isDelete,
/* 상태코드/라벨 (enum 또는 String과 일치) */ CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '출고완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'SHIPPED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '승인완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '반려' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '출고완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '출고완료' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '승인완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '승인완료' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '반려' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '반려' ELSE '승인대기' END AS statusValue
FROM outboundrequest r LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.comId = r.comId LEFT JOIN outbounditems i ON i.outReqId = r.outReqId
mapper.select: WHERE r.outReqId = #{outReqId} GROUP BY r.outReqId, r.comId, c.comName, r.outDateWish, r.outDttmReq, r.outDttmAppr, r.isTempo, r.isDelete

SELECT o.outReqId AS outReqId, o.comId AS comId, c.comName AS comName, o.outDateWish AS outDateWish, o.outDttmAppr AS outDttmAppr,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '출고완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'SHIPPED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '승인완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '반려' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '출고완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '출고완료' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '승인완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '승인완료' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '반려' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '반려' ELSE '승인대기' END AS statusValue,
o.IsTempo AS isTempo, o.IsDelete AS isDelete, o.outDttmReq AS createdAt
FROM outboundrequest o LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.comId = o.comId LEFT JOIN outbounditems i ON i.outReqId = o.outReqId WHERE COALESCE(o.IsDelete,0) = 0
AND c.comName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{comName}, '%')
AND ( (#{status} = 'SHIPPED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbounditems x WHERE x.outReqId=o.outReqId AND x.status='출고완료')) OR (#{status} = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbounditems x WHERE x.outReqId=o.outReqId AND x.status='승인완료')) OR (#{status} = 'REJECTED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbounditems x WHERE x.outReqId=o.outReqId AND x.status='반려')) OR (#{status} = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM outbounditems x WHERE x.outReqId = o.outReqId AND x.status IN ('출고완료','승인완료','반려') )) )
AND DATE(o.outDttmReq) >= #{startDate}
AND DATE(o.outDttmReq) <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY o.outReqId, o.comId, c.comName, o.outDateWish, o.outDttmReq, o.outDttmAppr, o.IsTempo, o.IsDelete ORDER BY o.outDttmReq DESC

SELECT o.outReqId AS outReqId, o.comId AS comId, c.comName AS comName, o.outDateWish AS outDateWish, o.outDttmAppr AS outDttmAppr,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '출고완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'SHIPPED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '승인완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '반려' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '출고완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '출고완료' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '승인완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '승인완료' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '반려' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '반려' ELSE '승인대기' END AS statusValue,
o.IsTempo AS isTempo, o.IsDelete AS isDelete, o.outDttmReq AS createdAt
FROM outboundrequest o LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.comId = o.comId LEFT JOIN outbounditems i ON i.outReqId = o.outReqId WHERE COALESCE(o.IsDelete,0) = 0
AND c.comName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{comName}, '%')
AND ( (#{status} = 'SHIPPED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbounditems x WHERE x.outReqId=o.outReqId AND x.status='출고완료')) OR (#{status} = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbounditems x WHERE x.outReqId=o.outReqId AND x.status='승인완료')) OR (#{status} = 'REJECTED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbounditems x WHERE x.outReqId=o.outReqId AND x.status='반려')) OR (#{status} = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM outbounditems x WHERE x.outReqId = o.outReqId AND x.status IN ('출고완료','승인완료','반려') )) )
AND DATE(o.outDttmReq) >= #{startDate}
AND DATE(o.outDttmReq) <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY o.outReqId, o.comId, c.comName, o.outDateWish, o.outDttmReq, o.outDttmAppr, o.IsTempo, o.IsDelete
ORDER BY
c.comName o.outDateWish o.outDttmReq
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT oi.outReqItemsId AS outReqItemsId, oi.outReqId AS outReqId, oi.stkId AS stkId, oi.outQtyReq AS outQtyReq, oi.vehicleId AS vehicleId, oi.status AS status, oi.outOrderAddr AS outOrderAddr, oi.outDttmSchd AS outDttmSchd, oi.outDttmInsp AS outDttmInsp, oi.outDttmShip AS outDttmShip FROM outbounditems oi WHERE oi.outReqId = #{outReqId} ORDER BY oi.outReqItemsId ASC

SELECT s.stkId AS stkId, c.cfName AS cfName, c.cfCategory AS cfCategory, c.cfGrade AS cfGrade, w.whName AS whName, s.stkQuantity AS stkQuantity FROM stock s JOIN coffee c ON c.cfId = s.cfId JOIN location_places lp ON lp.lpId = s.lpId JOIN locations loc ON loc.lpId = lp.lpId JOIN warehouse w ON w.whId = loc.whId
AND w.whId IN ( SELECT wm.whId FROM warehouse_management wm WHERE wm.userId = #{userId} )
ORDER BY c.cfName ASC, s.stkId ASC

SELECT v.vehicleId AS vehicleId, v.vehicleModel AS vehicleModel, v.vehicleDesc AS vehicleDesc FROM vehicles v
AND v.vehicleId = (SELECT u.vehicleId FROM users u WHERE u.userId = #{userId})
ORDER BY v.vehicleId
SELECT m.managerId AS managerId, m.managerName AS managerName FROM managers m ORDER BY m.managerName
